environment.display: Private Xvfb with software rendering, 1600x1000 root and 1280x800 app
environment.isolation: Separate user/network namespace and disposable vault/configuration
environment.input: XTest ArrowDown held 2.8 seconds immediately followed by ArrowUp held 2.8 seconds; 180ms repeat delay and 30Hz repeat
environment.quantile: nearest rank, milliseconds rounded to two decimals
environment.timingCaveats: Sequential small samples with coarse clocks. Return includes transaction and up to 5ms DOM polling, not paint or physical input latency. Frame timing varied substantially even in baseline reruns. No other builds/tests ran during timings.

finalBuildDifference: After timing, code retention additionally bypasses fallback output when the highlighter throws. A malformed-grammar regression proves retry; successful rendering paths measured here are unchanged.
nativeInputHarness:
from pathlib import Path
import ctypes,time,json,re,subprocess,os,sys
phase=sys.argv[1];warm_only='--warm-only' in sys.argv;base=Path('/tmp/figaro-preview-retention')/phase
sys.path.insert(0,str(base));from native_inspector import Inspector
display_name=':'+base.joinpath('xdisplay').read_text().strip()
env={**os.environ,'DISPLAY':display_name}
for _ in range(100):
 windows=subprocess.check_output(['xwininfo','-root','-tree'],env=env,text=True)
 match=re.search(r'(0x[0-9a-f]+) "Cost.md — Figaro"',windows)
 if match:break
 time.sleep(.1)
assert match,windows
window=int(match[1],16)
X=ctypes.CDLL('libX11.so.6');T=ctypes.CDLL('libXtst.so.6')
X.XOpenDisplay.argtypes=[ctypes.c_char_p];X.XOpenDisplay.restype=ctypes.c_void_p
display=X.XOpenDisplay(display_name.encode());assert display
X.XSetInputFocus.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_ulong,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_ulong]
X.XMoveResizeWindow.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_ulong,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_uint]
X.XFlush.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]
X.XKeysymToKeycode.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_ulong];X.XKeysymToKeycode.restype=ctypes.c_uint
T.XTestFakeKeyEvent.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p,ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_ulong]
x=Inspector();x.sock.settimeout(60)
def key(symbol,down):T.XTestFakeKeyEvent(display,X.XKeysymToKeycode(display,symbol),int(down),0);X.XFlush(display)
def wait_done():
 for _ in range(1200):
  time.sleep(.05);p=x.evaluate('({done:remountProbe.done,error:remountProbe.error})')
  if p['error']:raise RuntimeError(p['error'])
  if p['done']:return
 raise RuntimeError('probe timeout')
try:
 X.XMoveResizeWindow(display,window,80,100,1280,800);X.XSetInputFocus(display,window,1,0);X.XFlush(display)
 subprocess.run(['xset','r','rate','180','30'],env=env,check=True)
 x.evaluate((base.parent/'probe.js').read_text())
 for kind in ['code','math','table','image']:
  x.evaluate('remountProbe.prepare('+json.dumps(kind)+')');wait_done()
  if True:x.evaluate('remountProbe.remount()');wait_done()
  for iteration in range(0 if warm_only else 3):
   x.evaluate('remountProbe.view.dispatch({selection:{anchor:0},effects:remountProbe.view.constructor.scrollIntoView(0,{y:"start"})});remountProbe.view.focus()');time.sleep(.4)
   x.evaluate('remountProbe.start('+json.dumps('held_down_up_'+str(iteration))+')')
   key(0xff54,True);time.sleep(2.8);key(0xff54,False);key(0xff52,True);time.sleep(2.8);key(0xff52,False)
   time.sleep(.4);row=x.evaluate('remountProbe.stop()');print(json.dumps({'kind':kind,'iteration':iteration,'keys':len(row['keys']),'repeat':sum(k['repeat'] for k in row['keys']),'markupWrites':row['markupWrites'],'imageCreates':row['imageCreates'],'mathRenders':row['mathRenders'],'rulerReads':row['rulerReads']}),flush=True)
   assert row['sourceIntact'] and len(row['keys'])>60
  result=x.evaluate('remountProbe.rows');base.joinpath('switch-results.json' if warm_only else 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
finally:
 key(0xff54,False);key(0xff52,False)
 x.evaluate('remountProbe.dispose()');x.close()
